sections.section_name: Section A - Objective Type / MCQs / True-False

questions.question_text: Which formula symbol is used to create an absolute cell reference in a spreadsheet?
What is the primary purpose of a Master Slide in a digital presentation?
options: A) To add complex animation to a specific image
B) To control the universal formatting, background, and layout of all slides
C) To print speaker notes and audience handouts
D) To insert external video files
questions.answer: B) To control the universal formatting, background, and layout of all slides

questions.question_text: True or False: A strong password should only contain lowercase letters to make it easier to remember and type quickly without errors.
Which function in an electronic spreadsheet is used to find the highest numerical value in a selected range of cells?
In digital presentations, what are 'Animation Triggers' used for?
options: A) To start an animation effect when a specific object on the slide is clicked
B) To change the background color of the entire slide deck
C) To transition between two different presentation files
D) To save the presentation file automatically on a timer
questions.answer: A) To start an animation effect when a specific object on the slide is clicked

questions.question_text: Which of the following is considered a primary method of malware infection on a computer system?
options: A) Saving a presentation as a PDF document
B) Using a strong alphanumeric password
C) Downloading attachments from unknown or suspicious emails
D) Updating the operating system to the latest version
questions.answer: C) Downloading attachments from unknown or suspicious emails

questions.question_text: In an electronic spreadsheet, how is a continuous cell range from A1 to A10 properly represented?
True or False: Filtering data in a spreadsheet permanently deletes the data rows that do not match the selected filtering criteria.
What type of cyber threat involves malicious software locking a user's files and demanding a financial payment to restore access?
Which presentation view is best suited for quickly sorting, rearranging, and deleting multiple slides at once?
Explain the mechanical difference between an Absolute Cell Reference and a Relative Cell Reference when copying formulas down a column. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Relative references change automatically based on the relative position of rows and columns. Absolute references stay locked to a specific cell address using dollar signs when the formula is copied.

questions.question_text: Define what a slide transition is and explain how it differs from a custom slide animation. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A slide transition is the visual effect that occurs when moving from one slide to the next. Custom animation applies movement to individual elements like text or images within a single slide.

questions.question_text: State two primary visual signs that a website might be unsafe for entering sensitive personal or financial information. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Unsafe websites often lack the HTTPS protocol, indicated by a missing padlock icon in the address bar, and they may feature strange domain names or excessive, aggressive pop-up advertisements.

questions.question_text: What is the primary operational purpose of the AutoFill handle feature in an electronic spreadsheet? [15-25 words]
questions.answer: AutoFill automatically populates adjacent cells with sequential data, such as days of the week or numerical patterns, significantly saving manual data entry time.

questions.question_text: Define the term 'firewall' in the context of computer network security and threat detection. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A firewall is a network security system that monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic based on predetermined rules, acting as a protective barrier against untrusted external networks.

questions.question_text: Write out the step-by-step spreadsheet formula layout needed to compute the average score of cells from B2 to B15, and state how to apply a conditional filter. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Use the formula =AVERAGE(B2:B15) in the target cell. To apply a filter, select the column header row, click the 'Data' menu tab, choose 'Filter', and set conditional metrics to view data points meeting specific marks criteria.

questions.question_text: Describe the specific configuration process required to add an audio music track so that it plays continuously across multiple slides in a digital presentation. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Go to the 'Insert' tab, select 'Audio', and choose your file. Select the audio icon, navigate to the 'Playback' settings, and check the options to 'Play across slides' and 'Loop until stopped' for continuous background music.

questions.question_text: Read the following case context: An employee receives an urgent email claiming his bank account layout is suspended and includes a hyperlink requesting immediate password updates. Deduce the specific cyber threat taking place, and outline four safety guidelines he must implement to keep his system secure. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: This cyber threat is called phishing, a deceptive method used to steal sensitive personal credentials. To maintain safety, the user must avoid clicking unverified links, check the sender's official email domain suffix, configure multi-factor authentication locks, and report the message to network security officers while running updated antivirus software sweeps.

questions.question_text: A teacher has compiled class marks in a spreadsheet from C2 to C40. She wants to automatically highlight failing marks (below 40) in red. Explain the spreadsheet feature used to achieve this. Additionally, explain how she can protect the workbook file to prevent students from altering the marks. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: She should use 'Conditional Formatting' on cells C2 to C40, setting a rule to format cells containing values less than 40 with a red fill. To secure the data, she must access the 'Review' tab, select 'Protect Sheet' or 'Protect Workbook', and configure a strong password to restrict unauthorized editing.
